name: Circle of the Ocean (Druid Circle)
body:
Your heart belongs to the fathomless reaches beneath the waves.

Bonus Spells: hydraulic push (1st), slipstream (2nd), water walk (3rd), control water (4th), ice storm (5th), fluid form (6th). vortex (7th), horrid wilting (8th), tsunami (9th).

Manifestation: Your skin is always cool and damp to the touch, the smell of seaweed and salt follow wherever you go and you may even leave the occasional wet footprint if you aren’t careful.

Granted Powers: You gain the following abilities as part of this circle.

Aquatic Nature (Ex)

You can walk on liquids as though constantly under the effect of water walk. You also gain a swim speed of 30 ft and can breathe and speak underwater. At 8th level, while immersed in water, you gain blindsense 30 feet. At 16th level, you gain a swim speed of 60 feet and blindsense of 60 feet in water.

Hard Water (Su)

At 8th level, you may cause a number of 5 foot cubes of water equal to your class level to become harder than normal water. This area of water is treated as difficult terrain, and any creature that begins their turn in the area must make a Fortitude saving throw vs a DC equal to 10 + your class level + your Charisma modifier or be ejected to the nearest non-hardened area of their choice.

At 16th level, areas of water become impassable to movement, but do not block line of effect.

Ocean Spell (Ex)

At 16th level, when you cast water spells within water, your spells have a larger and greater effect. The range and area of effect quadruples, and you can choose any number of targets or any amount of area within the spell’s area of effect to not be affected.

Druidic talents

The following talents are available to legendary druids with this circle:

Command the Seas (Su)

(Major Talent)

You gain telepathy (100 feet) and can communicate with creatures with a swim speed or the aquatic or water types regardless of intelligence. You may cast suggestion on such creatures at-will as a spell-like ability.

Crashing Waves (Ex)

(Minor Talent)

When you cast hydraulic push as a legendary druid spell, you may use it to perform a disarm, dirty trick (blind or dazzle), or trip combat maneuver instead of a bull rush. This choice is made at the time of casting.

Salty Spray (Su)

(Minor Talent)

Your blood has turned to harsh seawater. Whenever you are damaged by a melee attack that deals slashing or piercing damage, a harsh spray spits forth from the wound dealing half your level + your Constitution modifier to the creature which made the attack. The creature may make a reflex saving throw to reduce this damage by half. The save DC is 10 + half legendary druid level + your Constitution modifier.

Seamaker (Sp)

(Major Talent)

You may use the spell control water as a spell-like ability usable at will. When used this way, the effect lasts for 1 round per class level.
